 The Stars Show the Kind of Day You’ll Have: 5-Dynamic; 4-Positive; 3-Average; 2-So-so; 1-Difficult

 By Georgia Nicols | Royal Stars PUBLISHED: October 29, 2026 at 1:00 AM MDT Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... Moon Alert: Avoid shopping (except for food and gas) and important decisions from 5 p.m. to 10:30 p.m. Eastern Time (2 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. Pacific Time). After that, the Moon moves from GEMINI into CANCER.
 Happy Birthday for Thursday, Oct. 29, 2026:
 You’re a natural leader who is innovative, independent and skillful. You are resourceful and have an excellent clarity of vision. This year is about creating solid foundations in your life. Simplicity is key. Take charge of your health. Physical exercise will play an important role. Stay grounded and levelheaded. 
 ARIES
 (March 21-April 19) 
★★★★★
Communications with others will be upbeat and enthusiastic today because you’re in a positive frame of mind. You might be involved with ex-partners and friends from your past. It’s a great day to socialize and enjoy sports events and fun times with kids. You’re on your game! Tonight: Relax. 
 TAURUS
 (April 20-May 20) 
★★★★
Financial negotiations will go well today, especially anything related to home and family or a home business. You might spend money on home improvements. (Check the Moon Alert!) Relations with co-workers are positive. Ex-partners and spouses might be on the scene. Tonight: Discussions. 
 GEMINI
 (May 21-June 20) 
★★★★★
Today the Moon is in your sign, dancing beautifully with fiery Mars, lucky Jupiter and fair Venus. You couldn’t ask for more! This is a great day to get your hair done or have beauty appointments of any kind. Relations with others will be warm and energetic. Ask for what you want today! Tonight: Check your money and possessions. 
 CANCER
 (June 21-July 22) 
★★★★
This is a feel-good day for you. You might be mulling over some moneymaking ideas. You also might contemplate a major expenditure. Plans to entertain at home will please you, along with efforts to redecorate or make where you live look more attractive. Expect to encounter old flames. Tonight: You win! 
 LEO
 (July 23-Aug. 22) 
★★★★★
Today you’re full of innovative ideas that can help you write, promote, teach, act and connect with others. Oh yes, you’re in the zone! People are attracted to you because they want to hear what you have to say. Look for ways to make money from communications. Tonight: Enjoy privacy. 
 VIRGO
 (Aug. 23-Sept. 22) 
★★★★
You make a fabulous impression on others today, which is why you can further your own best interests. Demand the advantage. You’re high-viz and you look good. You might receive money that was delayed. Alternatively, you might buy something you’ve been wanting for a while. Check the Moon Alert! Tonight: Be friendly. 
 LIBRA
 (Sept. 23-Oct. 22) 
★★★★
It’s a fantastic day to travel. People are attracted to you. You’re full of energy, curiosity and goodwill. You’ll be generous and, in turn, people will be generous to you. Make travel plans and explore opportunities in publishing, the media, medicine, higher education and the law. Tonight: You’re admired. 
 SCORPIO
 (Oct. 23-Nov. 21) 
★★★★
Financial discussions will favor you today, which is why this is a good day to discuss inheritances, banking details, insurance issues and anything to do with shared property. Check the Moon Alert before you agree to anything, and because Mercury is retrograde in your sign, double-check details! Tonight: Explore and learn! 
 SAGITTARIUS
 (Nov. 22-Dec. 21) 
★★★★
You feel optimistic today; you feel that good things will happen. And there’s a strong chance you’re right. Relations with bosses and authority figures are excellent. Travel plans are favored. Education and writing are blessed today! Tonight: Check your finances. 
 CAPRICORN
 (Dec. 22-Jan. 19) 
★★★★
This is a productive day for you at work and in your personal chores, including issues related to your health. Financial and practical support that you need will be there for you. It’s also a good day to ask for permission or approval from authority figures. Tonight: Be cooperative. 
 AQUARIUS
 (Jan. 20-Feb. 18) 
★★★★★
Accept invitations to party and schmooze today. This is a fun-loving day! Enjoy social outings, sports events, fun activities with kids and a chance to express your creative talents. Romance is blessed, especially an attraction to someone “different.” Tonight: Get better organized. 
 PISCES
 (Feb. 19-March 20) 
★★★★
Working from home as well as family discussions will go well today. In particular, exploring innovative ideas, writing and interacting with family members will be productive and rewarding. Delayed money might arrive. Yes! Tonight: Relax at home.
